name: as_of_month_day crossed with qb yields four distinct keeptradecut joins
description: generate_table_alias must fold as_of_month_day into its hash key. The file's own history is the reason: omitting is_superflex from that key once collapsed two columns onto one alias and rendered the 1QB value under the superflex column, silently and with no error. This requests the same metric four times across two anchors (03-01, 09-01) and two qb values, and the emitted SQL must carry four distinct table aliases and four separate joins. A build that dropped as_of_month_day from the key emits two.
